294.matn: ʿAlī ibn ʿAbdillāh narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: I heard ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim say: I heard al-Qāsim say: I heard ʿĀʾisha say: “We set out intending nothing but Ḥajj. When we were at Sarif, I menstruated. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came in to me while I was weeping. He said: What is the matter with you, have you menstruated? I said: Yes. He said: This is a matter that Allah has decreed for the daughters of Ādam. So do what the pilgrim does, except do not circumambulate the House. She said: And the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sacrificed cows on behalf of his wives.”
294.sharh: AI summary, with no invented page number: Al-Bukhārī places the hadith under the chapter “How menstruation began.” ʿĀʾisha reports that she began to menstruate at Sarif on the pilgrimage and wept. The Prophet tells her this is something Allah decreed for the daughters of Ādam, and instructs her to do everything the pilgrim does except circumambulate the House. At the end it is mentioned that the Prophet sacrificed cows on behalf of his wives.

295.matn: ʿAbdullāh ibn Yūsuf narrated to us, he said: Mālik narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwa, from his father, from ʿĀʾisha, she said: “I used to comb the head of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, while I was menstruating.”
295.sharh: AI summary, with no invented page number: Al-Bukhārī places the hadith under the chapter “The menstruating woman washing and combing her husband’s head.” ʿĀʾisha reports that she combed the Prophet’s head while she was menstruating.

296.matn: Ibrāhīm ibn Mūsā narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn Yūsuf narrated to us that Ibn Jurayj told them, he said: Hishām told me, from ʿUrwa, that he was asked: “May a menstruating woman serve me, or may a woman come near me while she is junub? ʿUrwa said: All of that is easy for me, and each of those serves me, and there is no harm in any of it for anyone. ʿĀʾisha told me that she used to comb – meaning the head of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace – while she was menstruating, and the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was then secluded in the mosque, bringing his head close to her while she was in her room, and she would comb it while she was menstruating.”
296.sharh: AI summary, with no invented page number: Al-Bukhārī places the hadith under the same chapter “The menstruating woman washing and combing her husband’s head.” It is a statement of ʿUrwa, who, when asked, declares service by a menstruating woman unobjectionable and relies on ʿĀʾisha’s report. He then reports that the Prophet was secluded in the mosque, inclined his head toward her, and she combed it in her room.

297.matn: Abū Nuʿaym al-Faḍl ibn Dukayn narrated to us, he heard Zuhayr, from Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyya: His mother told him: ʿĀʾisha told her that the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, “used to lean in my lap while I was menstruating, and then recite the Qur’an.”
297.sharh: AI summary, with no invented page number: Al-Bukhārī places the hadith under the chapter “A man reciting in his wife’s lap while she is menstruating.” ʿĀʾisha reports that the Prophet leaned in her lap while she was menstruating and then recited the Qur’an.

298.matn: al-Makkī ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Salama: Zaynab, the daughter of Umm Salama, told him: Umm Salama told her, she said: “While I was lying with the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, in a cloak (khamīṣa), I menstruated. So I slipped away and took my menstruation clothes. He said: Have you menstruated? I said: Yes. Then he called me, and I lay down with him in the soft blanket (khamīla).”
298.sharh: AI summary, with no invented page number: Al-Bukhārī places the hadith under the same chapter “A man reciting in his wife’s lap while she is menstruating.” Umm Salama reports that she was lying with the Prophet, began to menstruate, withdrew and took her menstruation clothes, and that he then called her, so she lay down with him again.
